title: Alliance Duel
subtitle: Daily scoring & Full Preparation sync
key: Save resources for the correct Alliance Duel day.
Synchronize the day's theme with Full Preparation whenever possible.
Use the 08:00 AT and 20:00 AT matching windows for efficient double scoring.
Enemy Buster has no Full Preparation synchronization.

title: Server War / SvS
subtitle: Point strategy before invasion day
key: The goal is to win the point race and become the invading state.
Prioritize Versus wins, Arena, Full Preparation, trucks and Fury Lord scoring.
Do not plunder trucks or Bounty Missions from State 769.
Combine Alliance Versus with Full Preparation to score more efficiently.

title: Zombie Siege
subtitle: Alliance reinforcement strategy
key: Strong players send one reinforcement to weaker members early.
As waves become stronger, survive as long as possible without risking a chance.
After two losses, stop defending yourself and reinforce members still standing.
Use your strongest hero formation when supporting survivors.

title: Zombie Tyrant
subtitle: Efficient rally rotation
key: Fill rallies already in progress before opening another.
Launch a new rally only when active rallies are filled.
Faster rally departures mean more attacks over the event duration.
Keep rallies cycling to maximize total alliance damage.

title: Tank Fast Travel
subtitle: Move formations faster through allied HQs
key: Fast travel only works when the formation starts from your own HQ.
Drag your formation from your HQ to an allied HQ in the direction you want to travel.
Then drag the march from the allied HQ to the target area.
Useful for invasions, defense and crashed-helicopter radar events.

title: Apocalypse Time
subtitle: Reset time by region
key: AT means Apocalypse Time.
Use the infographic as a quick regional reset reference.
Timezone and daylight-saving rules can change depending on region.
Always double-check your local timezone before scheduled events.
